gloss: thin skin; thin peel; thin membrane

definitions.gloss: thin skin; thin peel; thin membrane
definitions.explanation: A thin outer layer — the skin of a fruit, the membrane around a peanut or section of citrus, or a thin pastry skin around a bun or dumpling.

examples.japanese: ミカン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄皮|うすかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく。
examples.english: To peel off the thin skin of a mandarin section.

examples.japanese: {薄皮|うすかわ}⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あんこ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A thin-skin manju is packed full of sweet bean paste.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄皮|うすかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はぐよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: His illness is gradually improving, like peeling away thin layers of skin.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin) + ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ (skin). Refers to any thin outer layer, not specifically human skin.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄皮|うすかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく: to peel off the thin skin
- {薄皮|うすかわ}⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: thin-skin manju (with lots of filling)
- {薄皮|うすかわ}⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: a single thin layer

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{薄皮|うすかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はぐよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — "as if peeling away thin skin" — describes very slow, gradual improvement (especially of an illness).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {厚皮|あつかわ}: thick skin/peel
- ⟦{外皮|がいひ}→外皮：26297_gaihi⟧: outer skin/rind — more technical
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin; peel — general term
